description: This file defines the PerformanceReviewAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing performance reviews within the HR management system. It includes methods for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting performance reviews, with detailed validation rules and Swagger/OpenAPI annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: PerformanceReviewAPI
classes.description: Class to handle REST API endpoints for managing performance reviews, including list, create, retrieve, update, and delete operations, with validation and documentation.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of performance reviews, supports filtering, sorting, and pagination via request parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getAll endpoint.

methods.name: getFilterParams
methods.description: Extracts and sets filter parameters from the request into a search filter object.

methods.name: getFilterParamRules
methods.description: Returns validation rules for filter parameters.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new performance review based on request data, with activation control.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the create endpoint.

methods.name: getCommonValidationRules
methods.description: Shared validation rules for creating/updating performance reviews.

methods.name: setReviewParams
methods.description: Populates a PerformanceReview object with data from the request.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes specified performance reviews by IDs.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves details of a single performance review by its ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Validation rules for retrieving a single review.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing performance review with provided data.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validation rules for updating a performance review.
